papers_reviewed.title: Picking Winners in Factorland: A Machine Learning Approach to Predicting Factor Returns (JPM April 2025)
papers_reviewed.reason: 242-factor ML study shows factor momentum = ONLY ML alpha signal. Once controlled for, no ML portfolio generates significant alpha. 37-66% monthly factor turnover required. Directly validates H398A/H041a design (IMOM6+IMOM12 are implicit factor-momentum signals). Staged as proposal #2 (wiki update to factor-models.md). Also informs H406 design: must test on broader 50+ factor universe, not narrow 4-factor composite.

summary: 4 proposals staged (3 low, 1 medium). Key findings: (1) oracle3 Wang Transform gives quantitatively rigorous prediction market pricing calibrated on 291K contracts — directly applicable to H185 CPI pipeline; (2) JPM 2025 validates H398A/H041a design: factor momentum is the ONLY ML alpha signal across 242 factors, confirming our IMOM6/IMOM12 choice; (3) H406 designed as explicit factor momentum on broader universe; (4) CloddsBot for broad prediction market scanning. No pairs trading breakthroughs found — H316 (LLM pairs) remains best candidate. PEAD frontier: FinBERT still best for English 8-Ks (H174 confirmed). Multi-agent angle: no new papers beyond what's already in wiki.
